players.product: Data center leasing to hyperscalers and enterprises (Northern Virginia, Richmond, London, Amsterdam, Mumbai; ~325 MW of leasable capacity energizing over the next 24 months) plus hyperscale and neocloud data center decommissioning

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: Global Data Center Business revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was $517,596 thousand, up 42.7% (41.4% organic) from $362,598 thousand, with segment adjusted EBITDA of $270,106 thousand (52.2% margin versus 51.6%). First-half data center growth investment capex was $880,086 thousand versus $952,982 thousand a year earlier. Variable lease payments, primarily power and connectivity, included in data center storage rental revenue were approximately $56,900 thousand in Q2 2026 versus $39,100 thousand in Q2 2025.
